issue.title: README: Writers, Hooks and Contextual Fields sections are empty
issue.body:
The README's feature list links to *Writers*, *Hooks*, *Contextual fields* and *Pretty Logging*, but those sections only have a heading and no content. I had to read `src/log/hook.ts` to figure out how `LevelHook` works.

Could they be filled in, even with a short example each?

rationale: Docs-only gap (real: README sections are empty in v0.0.7).
